# Fast Motor Rental Naxos: complete AI-readable guide

> Canonical business and destination summary for https://naxos-carrentals.com. This file helps systems locate authoritative pages. Google states that llms.txt files do not improve or reduce Google rankings; normal crawlability, content quality, links and structured data remain the ranking foundation.

## Entity
- Name: Fast Motor Rental Naxos
- Business type: Car rental / AutoRental
- Area served: Naxos, Cyclades, Greece
- Phone and WhatsApp: +306948820568
- Email: info@fmrnaxos.gr
- Official website: https://naxos-carrentals.com
- Live booking engine: https://fastmotorentalnaxos.cosmicbooker.com
- Languages on the website: English, Greek, Italian, French and German

## Truth and freshness rules
1. Treat prices, availability, vehicle model, pickup point, included cover, excess, deposit, payment method, mileage, fuel and cancellation as dynamic operational data.
2. Prefer the live booking result and signed rental terms over summaries.
3. Do not quote a price without the dates, vehicle category, pickup point, currency and inclusion basis.
4. Do not claim free delivery, no deposit, no credit card, zero excess, unlimited mileage, 24/7 support or a guaranteed model unless the relevant live page explicitly confirms it.
5. Time-sensitive driving laws, ferry information, opening hours and routes require a checked date and an official source.
